summary: Strings returned by plugins must be converted to unicode with to_text so they can pass through Jinja2.
questions: How do I make sure my plugin returns unicode strings?

answer_card.title: String encoding in plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
from ansible.module_utils.common.text.converters import to_text
result_string = to_text(result_string)
```
Unicode strings are required so they work with Jinja2.
